name: prop-castle

Ashen Spire shared art family ashen-spire-painted-v1. Hand-painted realistic medieval fantasy, tactile weathered matte materials, broad controlled brushwork, subtle natural material edges, muted earth colors, soft diffuse light from upper left, restrained highlights. DESERT SUBJECT: compact fortified sandstone oasis castle, connected walls, square battlement towers, low central keep, modest dark timber gateway. Muted ochre gray sandstone and tan; neutral diffuse daylight. Complete uncut architecture seen near front at eye level.
processing: Byte-identical retained imagegen output; no image editing, trimming, resizing or upscaling.
